g.text: QRWTY | free and paid, without fragile subscriptions
PROPOSED — individual accounts only. Prices and limits still need selection; no live payments are configured.
Solid: request / read Dashed: channel delivery Amber: product rule Proposed, not deployed
A success URL cannot grant paid access. Repeat/concurrent checkout must not create duplicate subscriptions.
Duplicate and out-of-order events are expected. Stale workers cannot overwrite a newer subscription result.
Guest creation needs no card or sign-in. Every tier records clicks durably. Stripe is never in the redirect path.
No teams or custom domains. Paid price, numerical limits, merchant setup and live activation remain explicit release decisions.
